title: Fixture git inherits ambient GIT_CONFIG_* pins: the Go gate fails inside ticfac's own read-only review launch
body: Under this review launch's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE pushInsteadOf pins, tests in cli (triage, run --cloud, cloud logs), reconcile, runstate, runsignal, exec/subprocess and exec/cloudflaresandbox fail pushing to their own temp bare origins; with GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 all pass. A reviewer ticfac launches cannot run ticfac's gate; fixture git helpers should scrub GIT_CONFIG_* (and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL) from their environment.
